audience.primary: Founders of $5-50M companies who care about how their brand actually looks; and Black HR consultants, doulas, birth workers, and equity practitioners — the people Micah's work serves.

typography._note: The live Color Worlds faces, as lib/fonts.ts loads them (Pass-37). Corrected 2026-09-14 in Pass-118 on the operator's ruling ("go with 1"): this block still described the pre-Pass-37 Inter and Source Serif stack, so hooks reading it disagreed with .claude/CLAUDE.md. foundry stays "system" (Google Fonts through next/font, no licence file), which keeps font-license.sh's Klim check in force.

mono.use: Labels, section codes and data only: the DESIGN_BAR R1 narrow third. Never body copy or headings.

signature.description: Case-study hero title: 96px Inter Display 700+ pinned vertical word stack, GSAP scroll-resolve to caption + first still cross-fade. ~600ms hold.

view_transition.description: 600ms ease-in-out cross-fade between cream paper and theater ground on foyer↔theater navigation. Reduced-motion kill-switch in app/globals.css.

figure.description: The book's page-6 figure drawn once on load in the /playbook hero: dashed context-window line wiped in, saffron unwritten-rules line climbing on an ease-in-quad, an 80ms hold at the crossing while the marker stamps, then a break-through on ease-out. ~1.26s of visible motion, CSS only, no loop, no scroll or input coupling. Approved in writing by the motion-engineer 2026-09-01 as a FIGURE animation, NOT a second signature interaction: it is the artifact playing, not the site responding to the visitor. Granted an explicit exception to the R15 400ms entrance cap on that basis. Base CSS is the finished frame; motion applies only at >=900px with no reduced-motion preference. Scoped to /playbook.
figure.removed: 2026-09-11 Pass-112: WallChart.tsx deleted with the book. Kept as the record of the approval.

countup.description: Home /: the $20M+ figure counts from $0M to $20M+ over 1200ms (ease 1-(1-t)^3) once the figure is half in view, and the hand circle draws in from 0.6s, finishing at 2.65s. Runs once per load, on / only. Skipped (finished frame) under prefers-reduced-motion, without JS, on a deep link, and when the figure is already in view at load. Never couples to scroll after it starts. Operator exception to R13 and R15, 2026-09-11, decision 4; not a second signature.
